newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends down on strong US dlr overseas.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends down on strong US dlr overseas.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar closed lower against its U.S. counterpart on Saturday, reflecting the strength of the greenback overseas, dealers said.
The local unit ended at T$27.648 against Friday's T$27.637 close. Turnover through dealers was a modest US$136 million.
"Today's trade was quiet except reflecting the overseas trend," said one dealer.
Dealers noted foreign fund inflows for the stock market in recent sessions, but said they did not see such entries on Saturday. For next week, a T$27.62-27.68 range was expected.
